# discord_category_channel (Resource)

Manages a Discord category channel.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the category channel (1-100 characters).
- `server_id` (String) The server (guild) ID where the category will be created.

### Optional

- `position` (Number) The position of the category in the channel list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the category.
